before.question:
Determine ΔH from this reaction pathway diagram. Then sketch the same profile and label the forward activation-energy interval as additional practice. [1]

Energy profile: vertical axis enthalpy / kJ mol⁻¹; horizontal reaction progress. Reactants at 0, transition peak at +80, products at −40. Forward activation energy 80 kJ mol⁻¹; enthalpy change −40 kJ mol⁻¹; reverse activation energy 120 kJ mol⁻¹. Solution information belongs on answer side when assessing these quantities.
before.answer: ΔH = −40 kJ mol⁻¹ [1], because products lie 40 kJ mol⁻¹ below reactants. In the practice sketch, label enthalpy and progress axes, reactants and products, and the activation interval from reactants to the peak (80 kJ mol⁻¹).
